rationale: Manjot has been actively hiring Android and iOS developers for Ajath's mobile consulting work, while Saurabh is a backend and Android developer turned AI engineer with hands-on experience building production systems in Java and Python. Given Saurabh's builder mentality across AI tooling and developer tools—domains Manjot's team also operates in—they could explore how AI-augmented development might fit into Ajath's service offerings or discuss technical collaboration on mobile + backend infrastructure.
intro_message: Manjot Singh, meet Saurabh Khire — Saurabh's Android and backend development background aligns with roles you've been hiring for, and his shift into AI engineering could be interesting for exploring AI-native tooling in your mobile consulting practice.
